profile.headline: Building and solving problems with software for impactful organizations.
profile.summary:
I'm a do-er. Discontent to the point of wanting to actively make a change. I have a vision of a world that is fairer, cleaner, and inclusive. I believe in working towards a society where growth does not equate to social disparities or environmental decline.

Coupled with my interest in social and environmental equity is my ability to use data as a vehicle for telling a story. Professionally, I see myself merging my personal strengths by leveraging data to answer some of the most pressing questions related to resource use, climate change, and economic disparities.

Programming: Ruby, Python, SQL, JavaScript/ECMAScript, Bash, Git, Apex, SQL, NoSQL, AWS, Docker

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Focused on the transition from a legacy node.js system to ruby on rails, ensuring well tested, maintainable and reliable product components.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Testing · Ruby · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Delivered member facing product features while working with a team of fellow engineers, product managers and designers. The particular focus of this role is driving engagement on the platform by making product more interactive and customized for the user and their team. 

Technologies used include ruby on rails, react, typescript, apollo, graphql, storybook, heroku, docker.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · GraphQL · TypeScript · Heroku · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
In this role, I build out the InfiSense product to get sensor data into the hands of our customers with ease, standardization, and impact. My role is dynamic and requires me to see a project through design, implementation across the stack, qa, and deployment/maintenance. It's my job to stay up-to-date on the latest technologies and bring speed, dependability and sustainability to our software solutions. 

Technologies I use include Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, AWS (Dynamodb, SQS, Eventbridge, Lambda, Cloudwatch, EC2, Elastic Beanstalk) Docker, MQTT, REST API, Flask, and Git.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As a developer on a small team of engineers I contribute across our stack on production code but have a focus on our backend infrastructure written within a Ruby on Rails framework. My code contributions are source controlled, PR reviewed, and integrated through a CI/CD pipeline. The team has a strong focus on unit and integration testing. I work closely with Energy Engineers to translate their domain into software that serves our customers. The application is hosted in GCP and backed by a PostgresSQL database.

positions.title: Salesforce Administrator
positions.description:
In this role, I was primarily responsible for ensuring Optimum Energy's salesforce instance meets the needs of the business. I worked across the organization to deliver efficiencies, automations and design of the data that informs and governs the company.

My responsibilities included:
- Design of data infrastructure to enable scalability, generalized use, and support processes
- Source driven development using GIt, Github, and SFDX
- Deriving data insights through procurement of reports and dashboards
- Delivering automations and features on the salesforce platform that involve development work using javascript, Apex, SOQL, SQL and various CLI tools
- Supporting internal users with troubleshooting and training documentation

positions.title: Data Manager
positions.description:
My primary role involved ensuring that the needs of the business were met by the data systems and structures in place. Often referred to as the resident data guru, I was responsible for:
- Administration of CRM and Marketing Automation Platforms
- Management of data integrations across platforms
- Procurement of data visualizations to inform marketing strategy
- Design and delivery of automations to meet business needs

positions.title: Database Administrator
positions.description:
As database administrator for a non-profit, my role involved determining how to ensure that our data systems accurately held and reported on our programs to measure growth and evaluate success. Some of my main responsibilities included:
- Overseeing a database migration
- Managing API connections between Salesforce and other external applications
- Curating reports for development and program teams

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
As an administrative assistant, the role works across the various programs the organization offers to ensure evaluation, organization and promotion of the accomplishments of NAPCA
-Identify, research, and write stories related American Asian and Pacific Islander aging issues to be published on various website and social media platforms
-Update social media with fresh content three times per week
-Maintain and create databases related to donor and program data

company.name: National Asian Pacific Center on Aging

positions.title: Policy and Events Coordinator
positions.description:
Responsible for coordinating initiatives around improving national homelessness policies including housing initiatives and welfare reform which involved:   
   -Designing, administering and delivering events and conferences that reached over 300 politicians, local and regional stakeholders, think tanks, and other charities working on issues of homelessness
   -Producing speaking notes for the Chief Executive of Crisis
   -Organizing politicians and advocates towards the development of coalitions on homelessness issues
   -Representing the Organization at meetings with elected officials and private entities

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Supported the Research and Evaluation Department efforts to develop evidence to better understand the causes and nature of homelessness by carrying out:
   -Field work and contributing as a lead author on a study of social isolation and loneliness amongst homeless people around the UK 
   -Data analysis and entry through use of software such as SPSS and Excel
   -Writing and editing of internal and external vulnerable people needs reports
   -Consolidating data/findings into usable summaries and briefing notes

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Main project area contributions included entrepreneurship and climate change innovations through completion of the following:
  -Creating M.B.A related content for non-profit online entrepreneurship platform
  -Researching climate change coalition and global warming campaign public awareness materials
  -Writing blogs around current projects and approaches
  -Contributing ideas and research to online and upcoming events

positions.title: Volunteer
positions.description:
Social media volunteer for an association in London, UK that informs and advises restaurants on how to make sustainable decisions.  Responsibilities included:
   -Monitoring and contributing to social media outlets
   -Writing blog posts
   -Maintaining records of restaurant members using salesforce

positions.title: Campaign Organizer Intern
positions.description:
Worked with a grassroots initiative to organise a coalition of students, a diverse community, educators, and local representatives calling for greater transparency, affordability and assurance of water quality as the local council decided to lease Allentown’s water and sewer systems to a private enterprise. Responsibilities included:
   -Participating in activist strategy sessions
   -Reaching out to local congressmen and neighborhood groups 
   -Preparing leaflets and contributing to information requests

Project based on environmental racism in Chester, PA from a community development perspective.  8 weeks spent collecting surveys from local community leaders.  The data was later used as the foundation for honors thesis.

   -Aided the sustainability branch with efforts to reduce food waste on University campus’ as part of the federal Climate Action Plan

projects.title: The Limitations of Local Control on a Connected Resource: A case study of groundwater management in the Republican River Basin
projects.description: Groundwater management is an important governance structure to ensure the long-term sustainability of a resource on which many agricultural economies depend upon.  In Nebraska, groundwater is controlled by locally elected Natural Resource Districts (NRDs).  To meet the needs of a tri-state river compact, the NRDs in the Republican River Basin have recently built a large pipeline to offset groundwater use.  The following provides a summary of the contentions surrounding the decision to meet interstate compliance in this way. Based off of primary and secondary interviews with key stakeholders, this paper uses common property regime and integrated management theories to offer the limitations of local resource management of a connected resource.

projects.title: Honors Thesis
projects.description: Over the course of my senior year at Muhlenberg College I completed a yearlong independent research project that became the foundation for my honors thesis.  My study focuses on the environmental racism that the residents of Chester, PA are facing.  The residents of Chester have been burdened by the clustering of the waste industry within their city.  This has resulted in the continuous deterioration of the local economy and negatively impacted the health of the residents of Chester.  In my thesis findings I draw conclusions related to why the residents suffered from environmental racism and suggest preliminary mitigating response proposals.
